title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Lemon Kiwi 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Lemon Kiwi is a bright and zesty blend that pairs the sharp citrus bite of Lemon with the juicy, tropical sweetness of Kiwi. The Lemon brings a tangy, mouthwatering edge, while the Kiwi softens the profile with its naturally sweet and slightly tart flavour. This balanced fusion delivers a lively and refreshing vape with layers of fruity complexity. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation and double-concentrated flavour, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced blend ensures a consistent flavour with a tactile yet smooth throat hit and discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for customisable nicotine strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for its dynamic flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is crafted specifically for MTL vapers, delivering rich, concentrated flavours in a 50/50 mix designed for pod systems and starter devices.
